notes.title: City Z demo is now live
notes.content:
Hi zombie killers!
If you are interested in City Z but you want to test it before getting the full game, you can now download the demo on Steam.

[IMG]https://media.giphy.com/media/l3UcB2jE1kxvZai3u/giphy.gif[/IMG]

This demo gives you access to the Survival mode with a limited number of zombie waves.

So what are you waiting for? Go and test it! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: City Z 1.0.6 update
notes.content:
Hi gam@rs! ːz_antidoteː
A new update is available for City Z. 

Changelog: 
- [BUG] Fix player not moving on some computers.
- [Survival] Player announce next wave 3 sec before zombies spawn.
- [Survival] Fix weapons spawning under vehicles.
- [Survival] Fix zombies disappearing in map.
- [VR] Fix objects transparency when moving camera near buildings.
- [Survival] Duplicate weapon's drop when reaching bosses.

Thank you soo much for your support. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Trading cards and HTC Vive compatibility
notes.content:
Hi gam@rs!

City Z has now trading cards, badges, emoticons and beautiful backgrounds! Go and get them playing the game to increase your collection. 

[IMG]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6EhUrxrKw3EKiTFC/giphy.gif[/IMG]

Another important announcement is that the game is now fully compatible with VR. Both HTC Vive and Oculus are supported. A new VR trailer is available on the Steam page that shows a little bit more about how VR is used into the game. 

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/hbGvWyv.jpg[/IMG]

It looks like the survival mode is having success! More than 1.800 zombies have been killed for now and the first leaderboard positions have incredible scores! Well done zombie killers!

notes.title: City Z is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
The game is now available on Steam with a brand new Survival game mode and MAC OSX support. 

In survival mode you will have to kill as much zombies as you can and upload your scores to the Steam leaderboard.

We really hope that you will love the game and be sure that a lot of updates are coming soon.

Have fun playing City Z!

notes.title: City Z 1.0 is Live!
notes.content:
Today is the day, City Z is available on Steam!

This first release version includes:
- Campaign mode
- Survival Mode
- Randomly generated environments
- Random date, time and weather
- PNJ interactions
- Different types of weapons
- Full native VR

Have fun with City Z!

notes.title: The game is ready to be launched!
notes.content:
First of all, thank you so much for your support during the Greenlight campaign. As you may have guessed, City Z is ready to be launched this month as it has been approved for release by Steam ːsteamhappyː. 

--------- 

At first, the game will have a great Singleplayer campaign mode without Multiplayer.

It may sounds disappointing but be sure that we are working hard on getting a good online coop mode. 

--------- 

The game has been optimized for VR use and we STRONGLY recommend to play it with a VR headset.

Top-down shooters in VR are incredible! You have a sense of scale that is impossible to have on normal screens. 

--------- 

We hope that you will have a lot of fun playing City Z!
